causal_confidence.statement: The source links this two-allele genotype to the syndrome. The human p.Val557Glu substitution was modeled as fly p.Ile553Glu: rescue of null lethality under overexpression, shorter lifespan, and impaired bang recovery/locomotion at reduced expression support partial loss of function. This selected allele was among the experimentally modeled variants, unlike some other cohort alleles.

limitations: Ortholog substitution assays are not an assay of the human protein or the child; human reference cDNA fails fly rescue.
This audit does not replicate the laboratory assays or create an independent clinical truth label.
No inference about N1002K/BubR1 or arimoclomol efficacy follows from an INTS11 fly result.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All 29 packet features checked. The narrative reports bilateral optic atrophy, myopia, progressive cerebellar atrophy, balance/coordination difficulty, ataxic gait and speech apraxia. Packet negative myopia directly contradicts the case narrative; other detailed eye negatives are unreported. Broad normal facial categories are weaker than individual-feature examinations.

limitations: A broad category marked No is consistent with the detailed negative but does not document a specific feature-level examination.
Source audit is post-inference and aggregate-outcome exposed. It is neither preregistered nor independent clinical validation.
Genotype/source label remains supported with ortholog-assay qualifications; a phenotype contradiction does not mean the gene diagnosis is wrong.

Family 3 S1 describes progression to severe cerebellar atrophy; Table 1 describes mild/moderate. Table S1 additionally abbreviates MRI as Pcba, Het, whereas the narrative does not establish heterotopia. Those observations remain unresolved rather than silently harmonized.
Table S1 marks Family 3 hypotonia Yes while main Table 1 says N/A. Hypotonia is not among this packet’s assertions; it is not added to the frozen case.
Other families have source inconsistencies (including Family 9 hearing loss and Family 10 motor delay). Full reading does not certify that the source contains no errors.
The reference sequence check establishes transcript/local indel equivalence only, not original read-level truth.
